title: 第三章 伪君子

content_zh:
是师父这次完成了宗门的任务，所获得的奖励。记得师父曾经说过，他再吃这种药也没有用处，所以，就想在自己师兄弟三人之中，选一个服用。
春秋丹，楚阳心中一阵悲哀，这种在上三天扔了都没有人拣的垃.圾货色，却成为大师兄陷害此次自己两人的理由！
记得前世，这颗春秋丹，仍是大师兄石千山得了去……
直到谈昙突然出了意外身死，自己有一次去拜祭谈昙的时候，却无意中看到大师兄也在，而且对着谈昙的墓碑，说出了这件事被自己偷听到，自己才知道，这位自己和谈昙一向尊敬的大师兄，竟然是如此卑劣的一个人！
想到这里，楚阳心中叹息。前世的自己和谈昙，是多么傻……
石千山，身材瘦削，看起来很精练，二十三四岁。平日里，对楚阳和谈昙都是极好，平时看来，这个大师兄，几乎比亲哥哥还要亲。
却没有想到，这一切竟然都是假的！他自始至终，都是在利用楚阳和谈昙！他平时的伪装，全为了在关键时候踩掉两人，独占师门的修炼资源！
石千山为何要这么做，楚阳也知道原因。他乃是千方百计，要进入天外楼内门，获得内门弟子资格。然后成为整个天外楼内门弟子的大师兄，进入天外楼七阴汇聚之地！
只要进入了那里，便是下一派宗主人选！天外楼历代弟子，只有一个人能进入！
石千山，对于权势，有狂热的追求热衷！在他眼中，为达目的，不惜牺牲一切！
楚阳三人，乃是天外楼之中的外围。按照常理来说，绝对没有可能进入内阁。石千山想要进入，必须在一次一次的宗门弟子大比之中脱颖而出，直到最后！
这也是天外楼历代以来激励弟子上进的手段。
所以这春秋丹，虽然仅仅能提升一年精纯功力，但对这些年轻弟子来说，一年的精纯功力，却足以将同级的师兄弟抛得远远地！
前一世，石千山成功了。他从现在的外围弟子的身份，一步步往上爬，最终终于是进入了内门，有了角逐大师兄之位的资格。
但就在四年后，天外楼不知什么原因，突然被各大门派联手围剿，一夜之间灰飞烟灭！
而楚阳重伤之下昏迷了过去，被重重尸体压在下面，等到醒来，已经是三天后。
当时天外楼到处烈火熊熊，还未燃烧完毕。天外楼的主楼，在三天剧烈地燃烧之后，终于完整的倒塌，险些将当时不能动弹的楚阳砸在下面。
但在倒塌之后，在地基深处，却露出了一截剑尖，闪闪发光！似乎带着魔鬼的诱惑……
那就是九劫剑第一截剑尖。
楚阳撞大运一般的得到了九劫剑剑尖，从此才开始了他的崛起之路……而那时候，他已经二十岁！

而那崩塌的地基，在楚阳记忆之中，就是天外楼七阴汇聚之地之所在！
石千山做梦也想进入的地方！
楚阳的嘴角露出了一丝笑容，喃喃的道：“这七阴汇聚之地，石千山，这一世，可是我的！”
既然重生，既然提前了四年，那么这四年怎能浪费？一定要提前得到九劫剑！而要得到九劫剑，就必须进入内门，获得大师兄资格，然后进入七阴之地！
除此之外，再也没有别的办法！
“你说什么？”楚阳的声音极低，谈昙根本没有听见，只是见他嘴唇嚅动了一下，不由问道。
“我说……这天真蓝！这地真厚！这紫竹真好看！这花真香！谈昙你长得真潇洒……哈哈哈哈……”楚阳一跃而起，突然放声大笑，笑声清越，远远传了出去。
这刹那，楚阳满心振奋！前世所有的遗憾，将在今世弥补！
轻舞，等我！
这一生，我不会让你失望！
我要让你知道，你比剑好看！我要让你知道，这个人世间，你最好看！你最好看！
谈昙，好兄弟！我不会再让你死！
莫天机，**给我等着！
天道巅峰，我楚阳……要、登！上！去！
“嘿，我长的潇洒这个是有的，可这天这地这紫竹……有啥好看的……真是神经。”谈昙翻了翻眼皮，一道眉毛像天上一耸，另一道眉毛往地下一戳，咕囔着道。
“楚阳，谈昙！你们在这里吗？”随着一阵爽朗的笑声，一个青衣青年从紫竹林之中闪身而出。

content_en:
This is the reward that Master received for completing the sect's mission this time. I remember that my master once said that it would be useless for him to take this kind of medicine, so he wanted to choose one of his three brothers to take it.
Spring and Autumn Pill, Chu Yang felt a sense of sadness in his heart. This kind of rubbish that no one picked up after being thrown away for the past three days became the reason why the senior brother framed the two of him this time!
I remember that in my previous life, senior brother Shi Qianshan was still able to obtain this Spring and Autumn Pill...
It wasn't until Tan Tan suddenly died in an accident. When he went to pay homage to Tan Tan, he accidentally saw that his senior brother was there, and told Tan Tan's tombstone that he overheard him telling him about it. Only then did he realize that this senior brother, whom he and Tan Tan had always respected, turned out to be such a despicable person!
Thinking of this, Chu Yang sighed in his heart. How stupid I and Tan Tan were in the previous life...
Shi Qianshan is thin, looks very lean, and is in his mid-twenties. Usually, he treats Chu Yang and Tan Tan very well. It seems that this senior brother is almost closer than his own brother.
But I didn't expect that all of this was fake! From beginning to end, he was using Chu Yang and Tan Tan! His usual disguise is all to step out of the two of them at the critical moment and monopolize the master's training resources!
Chu Yang also knew why Shi Qianshan did this. He tried every possible means to enter the inner gate of the Tianwai Building and obtain the qualifications of an inner disciple. Then he becomes the eldest brother of all inner disciples of Tianwai Tower, and enters the place where the seven yins of Tianwai Tower gather!
As long as you enter there, you will be the candidate for the next sect leader! From all the disciples of Tianwai Tower, only one can enter!
Shi Qianshan has a fanatical pursuit of power! In his eyes, he would sacrifice everything to achieve his goal!
Chu Yang and the other three are the outer circle of the Tianwai Building. According to common sense, it is absolutely impossible to enter the cabinet. If Shi Qianshan wants to enter, he must stand out in the sect disciple competitions one after another until the end!
This is also the method used by Tianwai Tower to encourage disciples to make progress throughout the ages.
Therefore, although this Spring and Autumn Pill can only improve the pure skills for one year, for these young disciples, one year of pure skills is enough to leave the brothers of the same level far away!
In the previous life, Shi Qianshan succeeded. From his current status as an outer disciple, he climbed up step by step, and finally entered the inner sect, becoming qualified to compete for the position of senior brother.
But just four years later, for unknown reasons, Tianwai Tower was suddenly surrounded and suppressed by various sects, and was wiped out overnight!
However, Chu Yang was seriously injured and fell into a coma, being crushed underneath by numerous corpses. When he woke up, it was already three days later.
At that time, fires were raging everywhere in the Tianwai Building, but it had not yet finished burning. After burning violently for three days, the main building of the Tianwai Building finally collapsed completely, almost crushing Chu Yang, who was unable to move at the time.
But after the collapse, deep in the foundation, a sword tip was exposed, shining brightly! It seems to have the temptation of the devil...
That is the first tip of the Nine Tribulations Sword.
Chu Yang got the tip of the Nine Tribulations Sword like a stroke of luck, and from then on he began his rise... and at that time, he was already twenty years old!
And that collapsed foundation, in Chu Yang's memory, was where the seven yins of the Tianwai Building gathered together!
A place that Shi Qianshan only dreamed of entering!
A smile appeared on the corner of Chu Yang's mouth, and he murmured: "This place where the seven yins gather, Shi Qianshan, belongs to me in this life!"
Since he was reborn four years earlier, how could he waste these four years? You must get the Nine Tribulations Sword in advance! To get the Nine Tribulations Sword, you must enter the inner sect, obtain the qualification of senior brother, and then enter the Land of Seven Yins!
There is no other way!
"What did you say?" Chu Yang's voice was so low that Tan Tan didn't hear it at all. He just saw his lips move and couldn't help but ask.
"I said...it's so blue! This place is so blue."thick! This purple bamboo is so beautiful! This flower is so fragrant! Tan Tan, you look so handsome... Hahahaha..." Chu Yang jumped up and suddenly laughed loudly, the laughter became clearer and spread far away.
At this moment, Chu Yang was filled with excitement! All the regrets in the past life will be made up for in this life!
Qingwu, wait for me!
In this life, I will not let you down!
I want you to know that you are more beautiful than the sword! I want you to know that you are the most beautiful in this world! You are the best looking!
Tan Tan, good brother! I won't let you die again!
Mo Tianji, wait for me!
At the pinnacle of Heavenly Dao, I, Chu Yang... want to climb! On! Go!
"Hey, I have a handsome appearance, but this purple bamboo in this world...what's so good about it...it's really crazy. "Tan Tan rolled his eyelids, one of his eyebrows was raised in the sky, and the other eyebrow was thrust down to the ground, and he muttered.
"Chu Yang, Tan Tan! Are you here? "With a burst of hearty laughter, a young man in Tsing Yi flashed out of the purple bamboo forest.
